description: pipe-elbow-fuse's pipe pushed into the bend by one or one and a half tolerances (1e-7), turned about its cap's middle by a quarter of one or sixteen, or grown by a half to two. Arris fails: a cycle that does not turn once (Fault::Split, Turn; one in and the quarter turn), the torus and the cap's plane, or the pipe's wall, called tangent along a curve (Fault::Geometry, the section is degenerate; one and a half in, grown by one), the cap planes with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; the turn by sixteen), a piece of the rim matching no piece of the coincident cap (Fault::CommonBlock; grown by a half) and the rim circle a hair off the cap's plane with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; grown by two). The desired result is a clean union: the flush body within the tolerance, the generic one beyond (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
